title: Canada hoping to become EU’s first 'associate member' in deal
paragraphs: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney is expecting to finalise an agreement for Canada to become the European Union's first "associate member" by June.
Leaders from both sides have wrapped up a two-day summit in Montreal focused on forging closer economic and security ties.
Canadian cabinet ministers and European commissioners will meet in March ahead of concluding negotiations on the proposed alliance at European Council meetings in June.
